theme: A clear day before travel season kicks in
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — nothing on the calendar until Martin's noon call tomorrow. Good, quiet room to close out the Croatia and St. Pete bookings while the kids are settled here.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus sailing balance is due
needsAttention.detail: Invoice 2170 in your inbox shows a $6,475 balance for the Croatia course, and Amy's note flags the final-payment window is closing with the trip about two months out.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings still hanging
needsAttention.detail: Two p1 items in Todoist are past due — confirm the checked bags are actually on the Eurowings ticket (due Aug 25), and lock the single Cavtat night for Sept 19. Both have to be settled from dry land before you fly Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-21 gap — after you land at TPA and before the girls' Sept 22 pickup — still has no lodging. p1, due Aug 25 in Todoist.

needsAttention.title: Martin's Valoris call at noon
needsAttention.detail: Your one meeting tomorrow is the noon Teams call with Martin Steindl of Valoris Catalysts. Worth deciding tonight what you want out of it and the two or three points to open with.

flagged.title: Kuala Lumpur governance invite
flagged.detail: Kerrie Waring at CGI wrote Aug 24 asking if you'd come meet a new corporate-governance audience in KL — speaking slots are filled, but she'd value you in the room. Awaiting your yes or no.

flagged.title: Home policy up for renewal
flagged.detail: Liberty Mutual sent your home-policy renewal notice yesterday — a quick look before it renews on its own.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel confirmations — Airbnb, Enterprise, the sailing-materials shipment.

resolved.title: Japan board intro is on their side
resolved.detail: You replied to Furuta-san and JOMON in July to set up a call; it's been in their court since, with nothing owed from you.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: Peak summer squash is everywhere right now, so keep it quick and let the mozzarella do the rest.

acts.line: A clear calendar straight through — no meetings to break the morning up.
The open stretch runs right into the afternoon, the rare kind before travel season starts.
A quiet evening with the girls in St. Pete before tomorrow opens with the Valoris call.
